summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> dueling with one continuous, fluid sword sequence in a bright, clean ancient Chinese city. Their blades lock, and the camera pushes continuously from the crossed steel up to both women's glaring faces. <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> serve only as appearance references; no frame is a concrete first or last frame. The entire duel is shot as a single uncut take to preserve motion continuity.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic live-action wuxia style with bright, clean daylight and crisp color grading.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot reveals a pristine ancient Chinese city: grey brick walls, upturned tile roofs, red lanterns, fluttering banners, and a spotless stone-paved street in bright sunlight. At the center, <Subject 1> stands with her katana lowered while <Subject 2> faces her twenty paces away with her slender sword ready, their hair and skirts stirring in the wind. The camera pushes in slowly at normal speed toward the space between them, building tension.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the duel begins as one unbroken take with no cuts. The camera arcs around the pair and tracks their motion continuously as the choreography flows without interruption: <Subject 1> drives a fast forward thrust that <Subject 2> parries with a tight horizontal block; <Subject 2> immediately answers with a straight riposte that <Subject 1> deflects and sidesteps into a spinning slash; <Subject 2> leaps into an overhead downward strike which <Subject 1> catches on her blade and turns aside; the two blades grind together into a brief twisting lock, then they break apart with a synchronized half-step and reset to a centered guard stance. Every movement connects directly to the next, steel ringing on steel through the whole sequence, their footwork controlled and forms precise. The camera continues its slow orbit and gentle push-in throughout, never cutting.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, without any cut, the camera continues pushing upward in a single continuous move from the crossed blades at the lock, drifting past their gripping hands and forearms, up along their arms to their faces. It settles on a tight two-shot of both women glaring at each other: <Subject 1>'s fierce eyes and set jaw, <Subject 2> returning the burning stare, the metal of their locked blades glinting at the lower edge of frame. The locked tension holds into the final frame.

overall_soundscape: A soft breeze carries faint birdsong and the snap of cloth banners over the quiet stone street. Once the duel begins, rapid ringing steel impacts, swift footsteps, and fabric tearing through wind continue in an unbroken stream with no silent gaps. During the push to the faces, the metal grind fades into a hushed wind-only pause.

non_diegetic_music: A tense taiko-and-strings wuxia score at a fast tempo drives the continuous duel without breaks, then resolves into a single sustained low string note that holds under the final glaring two-shot.
